answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Endorsed biomass plant operator certificate with energy agency confirmation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Cloning 754 keys multiplies the price 754-fold: 69368 POA locked, or 9802 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. A delta of doubt is healthy, a signal of proof is required, and a ridge of patience is the price of a clean panel. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
